---
name: Implement Feature
description: Implement a feature across one or more repositories based on a plan created by the Plan Feature agent.
argument-hint: The name of the spec file to implement.
---
Read the feature spec file and implement it.

Use the /repos/ folder to hold work in progress. Any repos you need to update should be cloned there.

You do not need to make any commits, just update the code and/or documentation in the repos and leave it for the user to review.
